en_title: Zangief Actor Olivier Richters Really Wants to Play Tyr in the Live Action God of War Show
cn_title: 桑吉尔夫演员盼出演《战神》提尔
subtitle: 银幕内外都要练
opus_summary: 桑吉尔夫演员透露，自己曾试镜《战神》真人剧的奎托斯，如今希望饰演提尔，经纪人已向剧组表达意愿。他还在练习《街头霸王6》，希望以桑吉尔夫演员的身份用该角色参赛。

paragraphs.en: We got the chance to chat with Olivier Richters on the Street Fighter red carpet, who told us that he would love to play Tyr in Prime Video’s live-action God of War series.
paragraphs.cn: 我们有机会在《街头霸王》红毯上与Olivier Richters聊了聊。他告诉我们，他很想在Prime Video的《战神》真人剧集中饰演提尔。

paragraphs.en: Richters is a massive man. Standing over seven feet tall and weighing more than 350 pounds, it makes sense why he was cast as Zangief in the Street Fighter movie — and it’s also the reason why he wants to try his hand at playing Tyr.
paragraphs.cn: Richters身材极其魁梧，身高超过7英尺（约2.13米），体重超过350磅（约159公斤）。难怪他会获选在《街头霸王》电影中饰演桑吉尔夫，而这也是他想尝试饰演提尔的原因。

paragraphs.en: In fact, he credits it for being the reason why he didn’t make the cut to play Kratos when Ryan Hurst, who was previously cast in the role, was forced to leave the project after sustaining a serious bicep injury while filming a stunt for the show.
paragraphs.cn: 事实上，他认为，自己没能获选饰演奎托斯，也是因为这样的体格。此前获选出演该角色的Ryan Hurst在为剧集拍摄特技动作时，肱二头肌严重受伤，被迫退出了这个项目。

paragraphs.en: “I think I can be open [about it],” he told us. “I did an audition. I really got high up the chain, even got two callbacks, and eventually they chose Dave Bautista . Much respect for him, he’s a great choice. Of course, in some universe if he didn’t exist, I would have loved to play the role. Maybe in the future.
paragraphs.cn: 他告诉我们：「我想我可以公开谈这件事了。我参加了试镜，进入了很靠后的选拔阶段，甚至还获得了两次复试机会，最终他们选择了戴夫·巴蒂斯塔。我非常尊重他，他是个很棒的人选。当然，如果在某个宇宙里没有他，我会非常想出演这个角色。也许以后还有机会。

paragraphs.en: “Every year I’m acting, I’m learning more and more. If I’m really honest, I think there’s one character who suits me better, and that’s Tyr. I would love to play him. I don’t know if he’s gonna be portrayed in the first season or second season, but my agent told them, ‘Olivier wants to be Tyr.’ So, let’s see if it happens.”
paragraphs.cn: 「每演一年戏，我都会学到更多东西。说实话，我觉得有一个角色更适合我，那就是提尔。我很想饰演他。我不知道他会在第一季还是第二季登场，但我的经纪人已经告诉了他们：「Olivier想演提尔。」所以，看看能不能成吧。」

paragraphs.en: Richters mentioned this back in February on his Instagram account, showing himself decked out in a Kratos cosplay. “Realistically... at 7'2" / 2.18m, I might be too big for the role. I would literally tower over every other character. My real dream? A chance to audition for Týr. That would, in my opinion, be perfect,” he wrote.
paragraphs.cn: Richters早在2月就曾在Instagram账号上提到这件事，还展示了自己扮成奎托斯的模样。他写道：「现实地说……我身高7英尺2英寸，也就是2.18米，体型可能太大，不适合这个角色。我真的会比其他所有角色都高出一大截。我真正的梦想？获得一次试镜提尔的机会。在我看来，那就再完美不过了。」

paragraphs.en: While his future in the God of War show is currently unclear, he’s now reveling in the spotlight as Zangief in the new Street Fighter movie. In fact, he’s training in Street Fighter 6 right now with some seasoned pros with genuine hopes to be the “best” Zangief on all fronts — not just in the movies.
paragraphs.cn: 虽然他是否会参演《战神》剧集目前还不明确，但他正享受着在新《街头霸王》电影中饰演桑吉尔夫所带来的关注。事实上，他现在正跟着几位经验丰富的职业选手练习《街头霸王6》，真心希望自己能在各个方面都成为「最好的」桑吉尔夫，而不只是在电影中。

paragraphs.en: “I’m not lying — I’m really dedicated to becoming one of the best Zangiefs out there,” he revealed. “I’m not there yet, but I want to enter a tournament one time as the real Zangief playing Zangief. I just met a pro Zangief player, we spoke, and we’re gonna train together. If there is gonna be a second [movie], I want to be the ultimate Zangief.”
paragraphs.cn: 他透露：「我没说谎——我真的在努力成为最顶尖的桑吉尔夫玩家之一。我还没达到那个水平，但我希望有一天能以真人桑吉尔夫的身份，用桑吉尔夫参加一次比赛。我刚认识了一位使用桑吉尔夫的职业选手，我们聊了聊，接下来会一起训练。如果电影会拍第二部，我想成为终极桑吉尔夫。」

paragraphs.en: As a member of the fighting game community, I can definitely say that we welcome Richters into the fold with open arms and can’t wait to see him at a major someday. Maybe Evo 2027?
paragraphs.cn: 作为格斗游戏社区的一员，我可以肯定地说，我们热烈欢迎Richters加入，也迫不及待地想看到他有朝一日参加大型赛事。说不定会是Evo 2027？
